inference.bootstrap: cluster bootstrap over sessions, 2000 draws, seeded
inference.se: cluster-robust sandwich of the per-parent mean (CR1), Student-t with G-1 df

pin_iex.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

pin_nasdaq.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

sor.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

sor_sweep.inference: equal-weight mean per fill, CR1 SE clustered by day, Student-t G-1 df

simulator.note: costs are replay + adder: simulated fills never move the replayed book

two_venue.alignment: both streams on ns since the session's New York midnight, exchange (UTC) clock; Nasdaq ITCH as stamped; IEX: exchange_ts from the messages' own UTC send times (iex_clock='exchange', no shift) or, for a capture-clock (TAI) stream, exchange_ts/receive_ts - 37 s (iex_clock='capture'); merge order (exchange_ts, venue_id), each stream's own order kept inside a tie
